turns.text: real quick can u help me edit a text to my mom. she texted me this: "hey baby how was your week? and dont think i forgot, im keeping track of those loans in my notebook, ill pay you back every cent" i dont want to argue about the loans thing so how do i answer without making it a thing

Happy to help. The simplest approach is to answer her question warmly and not engage with the "loans" part at all, or acknowledge it lightly without agreeing or fighting about it. Do you want to send a draft so I can tighten it up?

ok heres what i wrote: "hey mom week was good. just tired lol, nights are rough and i barely sleep but its fine. made 5 containers of chicken and rice today for the week. how was ur week?" can u delete anything that hints im exhausted. i want it to be about her week not mine

Sure, I took out the tired/sleep lines and put the focus on her:

"Hey mom! Week was good. Just made five containers of chicken and rice today so I'm set for the week. How was yours? Tell me everything, did work calm down any?"

I'd also leave the notebook comment alone. If you want one light touch so it doesn't feel ignored, you could add: "Don't worry about the notebook, we'll figure it out later." That keeps it easy and avoids a back-and-forth about money. Want it shorter or more casual?
lol ok that helped. drop the notebook line tho. and ill keep the work question, just make it "how was ur week" so its shorter

Done:

"Hey mom! Week was good. Just made five containers of chicken and rice today so I'm set for the week. How was ur week? Tell me everything 😊"

Short, warm, and all about her. Good to send.
